_why: forge station additions to the CLOSED problem vocabulary (commons map/tags.json owns the rest). Add a tag here before any entry uses it.

problems.tool-trial: does this tool beat no tool on >= 5 frozen tasks of ours, with the authors' failed runs read?
problems.code-index: answer navigation questions from an index instead of broad file reads
problems.optimisation: improve a measured score by searching code variants
problems.holdout-validation: is an optimiser's gain real on data it never saw (frozen before the search)?
problems.wiki-generation: generate and serve a repository wiki with source evidence
problems.reverse-engineering: explain a shipped artifact from observed evidence, behind a recorded right to analyse it
problems.architecture-review: design a module interface twice and find deepening opportunities
problems.code-review: find actionable defects and intent-vs-implementation gaps in agent-built code
problems.telemetry-audit: what does a tool send, where, and which switch provably turns it off at the pin?
problems.repin: move a pin with the evidence first: licence, agent files, telemetry, repurposing
problems.noise-floor: is a claimed delta larger than the run-to-run spread of the unchanged baseline?
problems.ci-audit: does each check turn red on its own planted defect, and what does it cost?
problems.skill-authoring: write a kit skill or workflow with a failing test, a route and a listing line that earns its cost
problems.tool-setup: make a forge tool usable with one command: install at its pin in a run tree outside the station, telemetry off, keys by name, smoke-tested
